title: Motion tween: interpolate filter parameters across keyframes (filter tweening)
description:
Flash 8 Pro supports tweening filter parameters (e.g. blur X/Y, drop shadow distance/angle/strength, glow radius) between two keyframes that both carry filters. Currently the tween engine does not interpolate filters at all: TweenTarget (packages/core/src/tween/types.ts) has no filters field, so displayObjects returned by getTweenedFrame always carry the start-keyframe's filter array unchanged.

Ruffle (the runtime oracle) does interpret the per-frame filter list from PlaceObject2/3, so if the compiler emits per-frame filter updates with correctly interpolated values, Ruffle will render the smooth animation.

## Work
1. Add optional filters?: FlashFilter[] to TweenTarget in tween/types.ts.
2. Extend interpolateTween (tween/interpolate.ts) to numeric-lerp each filter's interpolatable parameters between start and end filter arrays. Flash's rule: matching filters by position in the array; if counts differ, Flash inserts disabled copies so arrays match — reproduce that behavior.
   Parameters to interpolate per filter type:
   - DropShadow: blurX, blurY, angle, distance, strength, color (per-channel)
   - Blur: blurX, blurY
   - Glow: blurX, blurY, strength, color
   - Bevel: blurX, blurY, strength, angle, distance, shadowColor, highlightColor
   - GradientGlow / GradientBevel: blurX, blurY, strength, angle, distance; gradient stops lerped positionally
   - AdjustColor: brightness, contrast, saturation, hue
3. Wire the interpolated filters back onto the returned DisplayObject in getTweenedFrame (timeline-query.ts), mirroring the existing colorEffect path.
4. Extend displayObjectToTweenTarget in timeline-query.ts to capture filters from the display object.
5. Add unit tests: a 2-keyframe motion tween with DropShadow(distance=0) → DropShadow(distance=40); frame halfway should yield distance≈20.

## Acceptance
- Unit tests pass for each filter type with interpolatable params.
- Canvas stage preview shows smooth filter animation during tween scrub.
- Published SWF has per-frame PlaceObject2 updates with the interpolated filter list; Ruffle renders the smooth filter animation (verified by the existing visual oracle spec or a new one).
